title: Ramadan ready plan
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y8 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ramadan ready plan)
intro: Lesson 27: Fasting: rules review and preparing for the next Ramadan. To understand the main rules of fasting and how to prepare for the next Ramadan from now

passage.title: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (Bukhari and Muslim)
paras: Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast, for it is Allah who fed him and gave him drink.

questions.q: Explain how the rules of fasting show Allah's mercy.
questions.a: Concessions for the ill and travellers (2:184-185: 'Allah intends ease'), forgetfulness forgiven, fidyah for those who cannot fast.
questions.model: Point: the rules show ease. Evidence: 'Allah intends for you ease and does not intend hardship' (2:185). Explain: the ill and travellers make up later; forgetful eating is forgiven (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.a: Can never fast or make up
options: Can never fast or make up

questions.q: Ramadan ready plan in the portal response box: three habits to start now (one Qur'an, one salah, one character), a monthly check, and one voluntary fast to try if able. Start: 'To be ready for Ramadan I will ...'
questions.a: A specific, realistic plan with three habits and checks
questions.model: Teacher writes the Qur'an habit: 'I will read two pages after Fajr every day, starting this week.'

questions.q: which hadith supports small regular deeds?
questions.a: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most regular, even if small (Bukhari and Muslim)

questions.q: Back to our ponder: what will you start now for Ramadan 2028?
